async def act(page):
    import asyncio
    # Click the Catalog link in the menubar to open the Catalog menu
    await page.get_by_role('menubar').get_by_role('link', name=' Catalog').click()
    await asyncio.sleep(2)  # Wait for the menu to open
    # Now, click on 'Reviews and Ratings' in the opened menu
    # Use exact=False to match case-insensitively
    await page.get_by_role('link', name='Reviews and Ratings', exact=False).click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    await asyncio.sleep(2)  # Wait for the reviews page to load
    # On the reviews page, search for reviews mentioning 'best'
    search_input = page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Search', exact=False)
    if await search_input.is_visible():
        await search_input.fill('best')
        await search_input.press('Enter')
        await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
        await asyncio.sleep(2)
    # Count the number of review entries displayed
    review_table = page.get_by_role('table')
    if await review_table.is_visible():
        rows = review_table.get_by_role('row')
        count = await rows.count()
        # Subtract 1 for the header row if it exists, but print raw count for now
        print(count)
    else:
        review_items = page.get_by_role('listitem')
        count = await review_items.count()
        print(count)
